about: AI customer-service reply golden set (SPEC-BE-086 FR2). The knowledge below is seeded into a temporary company; each case is one customer message with a reference answer written only from that knowledge and the keys of the sources that answer it ([] = the knowledge doesn't answer it). Grow it with real customer questions.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Inside Dhaka delivery takes 1-2 working days. Outside Dhaka it takes 3-5 working days.

faqs.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available everywhere in Bangladesh for orders up to 10,000 taka.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept bKash, Nagad, Visa and Mastercard cards, and cash on delivery.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: We send a tracking link by SMS as soon as your order ships. You can also follow it under My Orders in your account.

faqs.question: What are your customer support hours?
faqs.answer: Support is open Saturday to Thursday, 10 AM to 8 PM. We are closed on Fridays.

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get one free size exchange within 7 days of delivery, as long as the tags are still attached.

policies.title: Return policy
policies.body: You can return unused items within 14 days of delivery for a refund. Items must be in their original packaging. Underwear and opened cosmetics cannot be returned. Return shipping is free inside Dhaka and costs 120 taka outside Dhaka.

policies.title: Refund policy
policies.body: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 working days after we receive the returned item. Cash on delivery orders are refunded by bKash.

policies.title: Electronics warranty
policies.body: Electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty that covers defects. It does not cover physical or water damage. Keep your invoice to make a claim.

policies.title: Shipping charges
policies.body: Delivery costs 60 taka inside Dhaka and 120 taka outside Dhaka. Orders over 2,000 taka ship free.

cases.question: How long does delivery take to Chittagong?
cases.reference: Chittagong is outside Dhaka, so delivery takes 3-5 working days.

cases.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?

cases.question: What is the shipping charge inside Dhaka?

cases.question: How much is shipping if my order is 2500 taka?

cases.question: My headphones stopped working after 3 months. What can you do?
cases.reference: Electronics have a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects (not physical or water damage), so it can be claimed with the invoice.

cases.question: Is anyone around to help on Friday?
cases.reference: No, support is closed on Fridays. It is open Saturday to Thursday, 10 AM to 8 PM.

cases.question: Can I pay with PayPal?
cases.reference: PayPal is not among the accepted payment methods; the accepted ones are bKash, Nagad, Visa and Mastercard cards, and cash on delivery.

cases.question: Do you have a physical shop in Sylhet?
cases.reference: The knowledge base has no information about physical shops, so the reply should not claim one exists and should hand over to the team.
